title: The Oracle and The Prism: A Decoupled and Efficient Framework for Generative Recommendation Explanation
abstract: arXiv:2511.16543v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into explainable recommendation systems often leads to a performance-efficiency trade-off in end-to-end architectures, where joint optimization of ranking and explanation can result in suboptimal compromises. To resolve this, we propose Prism, a novel decoupled framework that rigorously separates the recommendation process into a dedicated ranking stage and an explanation generation stage. This decomposition ensures that each component is optimized for its specific objective, eliminating inherent conflicts in coupled models.   Inspired by knowledge distillation, Prism leverages a powerful, instruction-following teacher LLM (FLAN-T5-XXL) as an Oracle to produce high-fidelity explanatory knowledge. A compact, fine-tuned student model (BART-Base), the Prism, then specializes in synthesizing this knowledge into personalized explanations. Our extensive experiments on benchmark datasets

translated_title: 神谕与棱镜：一种面向生成式推荐解释的解耦高效框架
translated_abstract: 将大型语言模型（LLM）集成到可解释推荐系统中，往往会在端到端架构中引发性能与效率之间的权衡，其中对排序和解释的联合优化可能导致次优的折中。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了Prism，一种新颖的解耦框架，它将推荐过程严格分离为专门的排序阶段和解释生成阶段。这种分解确保每个组件都针对其特定目标进行优化，消除了耦合模型中固有的冲突。受知识蒸馏的启发，Prism利用一个强大的、遵循指令的教师大语言模型（FLAN-T5-XXL）作为“神谕”来生成高保真的解释性知识，随后由一个紧凑的、经过微调的学生模型（BART-Base）——即“棱镜”——专门负责将这些知识合成为个性化解释。我们在基准数据集上进行了广泛的实验。
tldr: 提出解耦框架Prism，将推荐排序与解释生成分离，借助教师大模型FLAN-T5-XXL生成高质量解释知识，再由轻量级学生模型BART-Base蒸馏合成个性化解释，从而化解LLM可解释推荐中性能与效率的权衡难题。
en_tdlr: Prism is a decoupled framework that separates ranking from explanation generation in LLM-based explainable recommendation, distilling high-fidelity explanatory knowledge from a powerful teacher LLM (FLAN-T5-XXL) into a compact student model (BART-Base) for efficient personalized explanations.
